audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Orianna 6 of 7 stages while Aurelion Sol wins 59.68% over 506 games, and phases[5]/phases[6] said 'Skill' where win[5] said 'Orianna' and win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Astral Flight at 4 gives a flyby trade she has no dash to answer, and the Rod of Ages / stardust curve owns both item stages. A 59.68% winner does not lose six of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Orianna / Orianna / Orianna / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Aurelion Sol ultimate was called 'Voice of Light' in spikes[3] and late, and Breath of Light was called 'Q Starfire' in early.
audit.why: His R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend; his Q is Breath of Light.
audit.corrected: Real names used, with the 410-unit Command: Shockwave radius as the contrast that makes the late-game claim concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and wants.foe[2] both called Command: Dissonance a 'shield-slow'. Dissonance is not a shield.
audit.why: Riot kit: Command: Dissonance (W) pulses damage and leaves a field that speeds allies and slows enemies. The shield is Command: Protect (E), which attaches the ball to an ALLY and also grants that ally armour and MR. Poking Orianna never strips it because it is usually not on her.
audit.corrected: Corrected in both places and the ball-tracking rule stated: the tell is where the ball is parked, not where Orianna stands, because Command: Shockwave launches enemies within 410 units of the ball.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or range numbers anywhere; the packet counted one sequencing cue.
audit.why: Command: Attack is 815 range on 7/6/5/4/3s — it out-ranges Breath of Light's 750 by only 65 units, which is the whole spacing problem in one number. Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into whys[3], whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, enemyWin and dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: Your wide-zone ultimate and raw scaling damage output overtake her utility-heavy kit in grouped late-game fights.

edits.before: Orianna's Command: Attack ball poke chips you every time you approach a wave, and Command: Dissonance's shield-slow zones your movement, so you lose the wave-trading war before your kit ramps up.
edits.after: Command: Attack chips you from 815 range on a cooldown that drops to 3s, and Command: Dissonance leaves a slow field, not a shield — her shield is Command: Protect on an ally, so poke does not remove it.

edits.before: Orianna's Command: Shockwave can pull a whole team onto her ball placement for a teamfight-winning engage, and she'll often play around this even in a 1v1 skirmish to set up a kill, while your R is comparatively telegraphed.
edits.after: Command: Shockwave launches everyone near the ball toward it after a short delay, so the tell is the ball, not Orianna — watch where she parks it, and remember her R only covers 410 units around wherever the ball sits.

edits.before: Your Voice of Light ultimate hits a wide zone that Orianna's ball-based kit struggles to fully avoid, and your raw magic damage scaling starts overtaking her utility-heavy kit — group up and force fights where your AoE outpaces her single-ball-dependent combos.
edits.after: The Skies Descend drags her whole side into one point and holds them in your beam, which is more ground than a 410-unit Shockwave covers — group up and force fights where her ball has to choose between shielding an ally and setting up the pull.

edits.before: Orianna out-ranges and out-pokes you significantly before level 6 — her ball chips you on every wave interaction, so farm passively with Q Starfire, keep track of her ball's position, and don't get caught in a shockwave setup even during a simple 1v1 skirmish.
edits.after: Orianna out-ranges you before level 6 — Command: Attack reaches 815 and drops to a 3s cooldown, so last-hit with Breath of Light at 750 and accept the chip, watch where the ball is parked, and never stand next to it while you channel the beam.

edits.before: Command: Shockwave is a game-changing engage/peel tool she'll look to land even outside of full 5v5s, so respect her ball placement heavily around level 6 and don't over-extend, since your own ultimate can't answer her pull-in combo fast enough.
edits.after: Command: Shockwave is on a 110s cooldown at rank 1 and only launches enemies within 410 units of the ball, so track the ball rather than Orianna: if it is on you, step off it before she casts, and keep Astral Flight for the moment it lands.

edits.before: Your scaling and wide-area ultimate flip this matchup late — once your core items are online, Voice of Light covers zones her ball can't fully answer, and your sustained magic damage output starts overtaking her utility-first kit, so push for grouped fights rather than skirmishes.
edits.after: Your scaling flips this matchup late — once your core items are online, The Skies Descend covers ground her ball cannot be in two places for, and a fully stacked beam out-damages a kit built around one shield and one pull, so push for grouped fights rather than skirmishes.

edits.after: Zone you off CS with Command: Dissonance's slow field

edits.after: Orianna wins by parking the ball on you, chipping with Command: Attack every 3s, and pulling you off your beam line.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Orianna on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, then step onto her ball line only when Command: Attack is mid-cooldown, and group — the beam holds objectives she cannot contest alone.

edits.after: Carry by scaling past her: her ball does one job per fight, and every stardust stack you bank is permanent while her cooldowns reset.

edits.after: Best wave: a back-line E execute pattern that clears from safety while you bank stardust — the wave dies and you never stepped forward. edits.after: Your E is a 12s black hole that clears the caster minions from 750 units, so you never step inside Command: Attack's 815 range to farm.

edits.before: That is Orianna’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Her ball out-ranges your beam by 65 units at every rank.
